question: A Flight of Pigeons is a famous book written by ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ruskin Bond**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ruskin Bond** is the author of the famous book **"A Flight of Pigeons"**.
 
• Ruskin Bond is a celebrated Indian author of British descent, known for his works in children's literature and fiction.
 
• "A Flight of Pigeons" is set during the Indian Rebellion of 1857 and tells the story of Ruth Labadoor and her family.
 
• The book has been adapted into a film titled **"Junoon"** by Shyam Benegal.
 
• Ruskin Bond has written several other notable works including **"The Room on the Roof"**, **"The Blue Umbrella"**, and **"Rusty"** series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ruskin Bond** was born on 19th May 1934 in Kasauli, Himachal Pradesh, India.
 
• He received the **Sahitya Akademi Award** in 1992 for his short story collection "Our Trees Still Grow in Dehra".
 
• In 1999, he was awarded the **Padma Shri**, and in 2014, the **Padma Bhushan** for his contributions to literature.
 
• Bond's writing is characterized by its simplicity and the depiction of the Indian rural life and landscapes.
 
• He continues to write and inspire new generations of readers and writers.
